summary:
DP World confirmed today that it had reached an agreement with Fujairah Ports Authority to build two new terminals on the UAE’s east coast – and outside the Hormuz Strait – under a 50-year concession.
The two facilities will be the Al Rugaylat container and multi-purpose terminal, and the Dibba general cargo terminal.
